name: Lucky
description:
You have an uncanny knack for avoiding the worst danger.

Whenever you roll 💀 on a fate die. Re-roll the fate die. You must use the new result, even if it is another 💀. The original 💀 does not count toward Bane/Boon, but 🌞 or 💀 on the second roll does count.

Describe how you cheat fate.
